name: moparse-dataset-v1-lite
review_record: All 800 selected physical input pages were actually read against the originals and current expected by visual-a (400), visual-b (200), visual-c (200). Only explicitly confirmed annotation scopes are frozen; unseen and unannotated material is not accepted.

freeze_record.basis: Direct author handoffs after actual page reading and comparison; no automatic inventory, count, hash, mapping, text or content acceptance.
known_limits: source categories remain unknown without independent evidence
annotation scopes are partial; no closed output precision scope
nonliteral references and formula typography have explicit NA scopes
known image references need visual output identity; filenames are not answer identities
freeze_record.development_exposure: Preflight and performance members, all source-document/family authoring exposure, and additionally viewed navigation pages are disclosed in sample records and handoffs; Lite is not an unseen independent-document test split.
